name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: A free, fully-offline alternative to ElevenLabs that clones voices, dubs videos into other languages, and turns text into audiobooks — all running on your own computer.
buyer: An independent podcaster, audiobook publisher, or video localization agency who wants ElevenLabs-level voice tools without the ongoing per-minute subscription cost.
business_use_cases: An indie audiobook publisher narrates backlist titles in a cloned voice instead of paying studio voice-actor rates.
A YouTube creator dubs their videos into multiple languages to reach international audiences without hiring voice talent per language.
A localization agency offers cheaper dubbing packages to small clients by running this instead of paying per-minute cloud TTS fees.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a dubbing/voiceover service for indie creators and small businesses, priced per video or per minute.
Sell audiobook narration-as-a-service to self-published authors who can't afford studio narrators.
Run a subscription service that batch-dubs a YouTube channel's back catalog into new languages monthly.

steal_this: Dub one popular public-domain audiobook chapter or a friend's YouTube video into two languages this weekend and use it as a portfolio piece to pitch paid dubbing work.
